mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.role_name AS name, r.role_code AS code, r.description, COALESCE( GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.permission_code ORDER BY p.permission_code SEPARATOR ','), '' ) AS permissionCodes FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 1
mapper.select: WHERE r.status = 1 GROUP BY r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description ORDER BY r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT #{roleId}, p.id FROM sys_permission p WHERE p.permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND p.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND rp.permission_id = p.id )
